content:
- Completed one improve-code-boundaries refactor in src/: flattened CLI connection command rendering onto canonical PgConnInfo.
- PgConnInfo now parses/renders sslcert and sslkey, and PgClientTls.client_key was reduced from generic SecretSource to plain PathBuf because conninfo can only represent file-backed sslkey paths.
- Removed command-layer DSN string assembly and wrapper materialization for primary/replica command output; cli/connect now builds typed PgConnInfo targets directly.
- Verification completed: cargo check --all-targets, make lint, and make test all passed (230/230 tests passed, 16 skipped, nextest reported 4 leaky tests but target succeeded).
- Committed and pushed commit fed3572 ("Flatten connection command output onto PgConnInfo").
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it exited successfully after updating current task files and sending email, but printed a benign rm message about missing .ralph/current_task.txt.

- Read prior progress: last completed task flattened CLI connection command output onto PgConnInfo, lint/tests/commit/push/task switch already succeeded there.
- Read improve-code-boundaries skill and smell docs 5 and 9 to choose one concrete boundary cleanup.
- Checked git status: unrelated local changes exist in src/process/worker.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs; avoiding those unless required.
- Scanned src/tests for boundary smells; likely candidates are typed-error cleanup in tests or another shared conninfo/rendering duplication.
- Next: inspect a few focused candidate files, pick one single boundary issue, then edit with apply_patch and verify with make lint and make test.

- Chose one improve-code-boundaries smell-5 cleanup in the HA test harness: remove raw conninfo string handling and keep the canonical PgConnInfo shape alive until the final connection/probe edge.
- Extended src/pginfo/conninfo.rs with canonical optional hostaddr support, including parse/render updates and a round-trip unit test.
- Updated all explicit PgConnInfo initializers in src/ to set hostaddr: None where appropriate.
- Refactored tests/ha/support/observer/pgtm.rs so PostgresRoutingTarget carries PgConnInfo instead of a manually rendered DSN string; host observer conninfo now uses the shared type and Display renderer.
- Refactored tests/ha/support/invariants/write_convergence.rs to operate on PgConnInfo directly for TLS detection and connectable conninfo shaping, removing string parse/filter/render glue there.
- Updated tests/ha/support/steps/mod.rs to render conninfo only at the psql probe boundary.
- Verification so far: cargo check --all-targets passed after the refactor.
- Next: run make lint and make test, then review diff, commit including .ralph files, push, append final progress, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
